channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: 25 ways to eat, drink and celebrate the Lunar New Year in Los Angeles
item.description: Celebrate the Year of the Horse with food and festivals around the city.

item.title: LAPD to train their body cameras on immigration agents, under mayor's directive
item.description: Mayor Karen Bass signed an executive directive requiring LAPD officers to activate body cameras during federal immigration enforcement operations and preserve all footage.

item.title: Notorious dead mall in Westminster is on track for redevelopment
item.description: Westminster Mall, a once-popular shopping center that has been desecrated by graffiti and vandalism since it closed last year, is on track for demolition and a revival that would replace the indoor mall with 2,250 housing units, a hotel, shops and stores.

item.title: She was found nude in a ditch. L.A. prosecutors say they've solved tragic 30-year mystery
item.description: Brian Walton of Los Angeles faces multiple charges in the murder of 23-year-old Claudia Guevara, whose body was found in a drainage ditch next to Encanto Parkway in Azusa on Feb. 21, 1996.

item.title: A dropped phone, a body in the trunk: Inside an L.A. Fashion District heist gone wrong
item.description: After a shooting in L.A.'s Fashion District, detectives sifted through encrypted messages to track down a sophisticated but clumsy band of thieves. They identified the suspects, including two who turned up dead. But what they were after — and who organized the job?

item.title: Climbers banned from Mt. Baldy as storm approaches, sparking backlash
item.description: The closure order has sparked a social media backlash from experienced climbers who argue their access should not be limited because of mistakes made by the unskilled and untrained.

item.title: L.A. mayoral candidate Nithya Raman's record may surprise you
item.description: Raman's stances on issues including homelessness, transportation, and protecting immigrants from the Trump administration are similar to those of opponent and former ally Karen Bass.

item.title: L.A. County officials push new sales tax to offset Trump administration healthcare cuts
item.description: L.A. County supervisors and healthcare advocates are pushing for a half-cent sales tax to cover services that are expected to be lost due to cutbacks in federal funding.

item.title: Why video of a masked intruder is such a game-changer in the Nancy Guthrie investigation
item.description: Investigators believe someone will recognize the intruder through their clothing, gait or appearance, giving the case crucial momentum after days with few leads.

item.title: Person detained south of Tucson for questioning in Nancy Guthrie investigation
item.description: The release of surveillance footage of a masked subject and the subsequent detention marked the first major breaks in the investigation, which has spanned 10 days.
